featured_reviews.name: Rukmini Krishnan
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was about a decade ago that I first started thinking seriously about owning my own property in Mumbai.

At that time, my uncle — who was working with WIPRO in HR — recommended Mr. Hemant Barabde of Tirupati Estate Consultants, saying that WIPRO itself had been availing their property services for more than a decade with complete satisfaction.

That reference gave me confidence, and I decided to contact them.
Through Tirupati, I purchased my first 1 BHK flat at Seven Bungalows, Andheri.
As my family grew, I once again turned to Mr. Hemant, who guided me like a trusted family friend and advisor.
I was initially planning for a 2 BHK, but he advised me to directly opt for a 3 BHK flat, explaining the long-term practical and financial benefits.

He also guided me on how to use income-tax benefits and how a home loan can help control unnecessary expenses while building a valuable asset.

That advice proved absolutely right — I saved significantly on taxes and became the proud owner of a 3 BHK home.

What impressed me most was his next piece of advice — not to sell my old 1 BHK, but to rent it out.

Since then, the property has been rented stress-free for 8–9 years, with Tirupati handling everything — even depositing my monthly rent cheques in the bank for nearly eight years without a single delay or error. The water tight  paper work amazed me.
Today, that same 1 BHK building has gone into redevelopment, and I’ll soon receive a spacious 2 BHK near the Coastal Road entry at Seven Bungalows — truly the reward of professional and honest guidance.
The services of Tirupati Estate Consultants have always been professional, ethical, and transparent.
They go far beyond expectations. I sincerely thank my uncle for introducing me to Mr. Hemant Nagorao Barabde and his dedicated Tirupati team.

Even today, as the firm has expanded into Real-Estate Mandate Sales & Building Development, they continue to serve families like ours with the same sincerity and values.

Their operations are clear, professional, and trustworthy, and the entire experience — from guidance to documentation — is always smooth and reassuring.

I wholeheartedly wish Tirupati Estate Consultants continued growth, prosperity, and the divine blessings of Lord Balaji for their honest and dedicated service to the community.

Finally, I must share one very special personal experience that will remain etched in my heart forever.
During my son’s wedding, I had always dreamt that he would arrive in a Mercedes car — it was a simple wish.
To my complete surprise, Mr. Hemant personally sent his own Mercedes for the newly-wedded couple to use. I became very  emotional.
That thoughtful gesture left me speechless — it was not just an act of kindness, but a reflection of his large-heartedness and the genuine bond he shares with his clients.
At that moment, he was not merely my property consultant — he was family.
Whenever i think of this incident, my eyes fills with emotion and my heart with gratitude — a priceless reminder of the human warmth which goes  beyond Tirupati’s professional excellence.

Rukmini K
